description: This file defines the CalendarAccount class, which extends a Basic class and encapsulates the data and behaviors related to calendar account integration within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, ACL management, list querying, and sync metadata updates for calendar account entities, as well as handling authentication fields and source changes.
